biotools.summary: The BiSim Tool is a user-friendly simulation tool designed to aid in the design and development of ligand-binding assays (LBAs). It facilitates exploring parameter combinations and understanding the dynamic equilibrium of free and bound fractions, ultimately saving time and resources during assay development.
